open_questions: SV_UserMove (0x8090e34) is partial: fn_080689a6 receives (ps, &baseline[1]); the meaning of fn_080ebf24(ps, byte) and of ps+0xd0 / ps+0xd4 needs the game playerstate layout.

client_s is partial: the snapshot ring (first dword of 32 frames, stride 0x26C4, base 0x236F0) overlaps the rate/netchan region and is accessed through COD2_CL_FRAME_TIME_PTR; the gaps 0x20e2c..0x6e6b7 and 0x6e6ec..0xae703 are not named.
The netadr_t by-value parameters (five dwords) are not expressible in the signature rule; the merge lane should confirm the ABI when it writes cod2_prototypes.h.
msg_t size is assumed 0x20 from the stack-frame offsets; MSG_Init must be checked for the real size.
SV_EntityRelevantToView (0x8091ad6) uses float instead of x87 long double; the constant 0x0814cfc8 is passed as a trace argument whose meaning is unresolved.
The download-error message in SV_RedirectClientDownload has two %s but one argument in the binary; the literal format is kept.
Placeholder callees are variadic (fn_08xxxxxx); the merge lane should replace them with their real signatures when they are known.

Several in-chunk names are descriptive only (SV_PrintTagged, SV_RegisterChatCommandNames, SV_DeferClientDrop, SV_RefreshClientRandomIds, StrNCaseCmp, SV_InitEntityBoundsAndLink, SV_EntityRelevantToView).
